hooks.command: summary=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" status --short 2>/dev/null | head -5); [ -z "$summary" ] && echo '{"systemMessage":"Working tree clean."}' || { count=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); oneline=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" status --short 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-120); echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"$count uncommitted file(s): $oneline\"}"; }
